description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'ExternalAssetOwnerTransferNotFoundException' used in the Fineract project to handle cases where an external asset owner transfer cannot be found based on provided identifiers such as external ID or transfer ID.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnerTransferNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException for cases where an external asset owner transfer is not found.

methods.name: ExternalAssetOwnerTransferNotFoundException(ExternalId, ExternalTransferStatus)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception message when a transfer with specific external ID and status is not found.

methods.name: ExternalAssetOwnerTransferNotFoundException(ExternalId)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception message when a transfer with a specific external ID is not found.

methods.name: ExternalAssetOwnerTransferNotFoundException(Long)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception message when a transfer with a specific ID is not found.
